title: CostSheetLines
description: Response schema of extract.cost_sheet@1, one reader's answer (BUILD_PLAN §14, F-10). The raw lines of a photographed cost sheet, feeding app.cost_sheet_reads.lines; the rules (core.cost_rule_sets) turn them into CostBreakdown, never a reader. No envelope: validated by the AI gateway directly.

raw_text.description: The line label as printed, e.g. "PLC (Park facing)".

code.description: A guess at the matching cost_breakdown.schema.json CostLine.code, when the label is recognisable.

line_ids.description: ai/ocr_page.schema.json OcrLine ids the line was read from.
